LESSON: MEALS AND SNACKS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.3: Meals and Snacks

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Meals and Snacks. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. differentiate between a meal and a snack from food items in the locality,
2. embrace the importance of taking meals and snacks at the  right time. meals and when they should take snacks, and snacks eaten through pictures, computer games

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. differentiate between a meal and a snack from food items in the locality,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to differentiate between a meal and a snack from food items in the locality,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. embrace the importance of taking meals and snacks at the  right time. meals and when they should take snacks, and snacks eaten through pictures, computer games
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to embrace the importance of taking meals and snacks at the  right time. meals and when they should take snacks, and snacks eaten through pictures, computer games. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Meals and Snacks.
2. Explain Meals and Snacks to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Meals and Snacks.
4. Show that you can: differentiate between a meal and a snack from food items in the locality,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Meals and Snacks. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Meals and Snacks important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. differentiate between a meal and a snack from food items in the locality,
2. embrace the importance of taking meals and snacks at the  right time. meals and when they should take snacks, and snacks eaten through pictures, computer games

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
